<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.lua from the @requires annotations in
     lua/noethervim/bundles/. Edit the bundle header, not this file. -->

Bundles are optional feature groups. The core works with none enabled.

Enable one by uncommenting its `import` line in `~/.config/nvim/init.lua`,
or open `:NoetherVim bundles`, highlight it, and press `<C-y>`. A diff
prompt shows the exact change before anything is written.

:::note
This page is generated from the same annotations `:checkhealth noethervim`
reads. Run that for the state of the bundles you actually have enabled.
:::

## Programming languages

### `go`

go.nvim -- test gen, struct tags, interface impl

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.go" }
```

Requires:

- **Go toolchain**: building, testing and every go.nvim command
  <br />https://go.dev/dl/

### `java`

nvim-jdtls -- proper Java LSP support

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.java" }
```

Requires:

- **a JDK**: jdtls will not start without one
  <br />JDK 17 or newer; jdtls itself installs via Mason

### `latex`

VimTeX + noethervim-tex (snippets, textobjects)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.latex" }
```

Requires:

- **latexmk**: compiling documents through VimTeX
  <br />ships with TeX Live and MacTeX
- **pdflatex** *(optional)*: the engine latexmk drives by default
  <br />ships with TeX Live and MacTeX
- **pngpaste** *(optional)*: pasting images from the clipboard on macOS
  <br />brew install pngpaste

### `latex-zotero`

Zotero citation picker

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.latex-zotero" }
```

Requires:

- **Zotero**: the citation picker reads its local database
  <br />https://www.zotero.org/
- **sqlite3**: sqlite.lua opens the Zotero database through it
  <br />preinstalled on macOS and most Linux distributions

### `python`

venv-selector -- virtual environment switching

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.python" }
```

Requires:

- **Python 3**: virtual-environment discovery
  <br />https://www.python.org/downloads/

### `rust`

rustaceanvim -- macro expansion, runnables, crate graph

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.rust" }
```

Requires:

- **rust-analyzer**: every rustaceanvim feature
  <br />rustup component add rust-analyzer
- **Cargo**: building and running from the editor
  <br />https://rustup.rs/

### `web-dev`

template-string auto-conversion + color preview

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.languages.web-dev" }
```

Requires:

- **Node.js**: the ts_ls, cssls and eslint servers Mason installs
  <br />https://nodejs.org/

## Tools

### `ai`

CodeCompanion (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.ai" }
```

Requires:

- **curl**: all provider requests go through it
  <br />preinstalled on macOS and most Linux distributions
- **A provider API key** *(optional)*: CodeCompanion cannot talk to a model without one
  <br />Anthropic by default; OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY and Ollama also work

### `database`

vim-dadbod + UI + SQL completion

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.database" }
```

Requires:

- **psql** *(optional)*: PostgreSQL connections; dadbod shells out to the client
  <br />part of postgresql
- **mysql** *(optional)*: MySQL and MariaDB connections
  <br />part of mysql-client
- **sqlite3** *(optional)*: SQLite connections
  <br />preinstalled on macOS and most Linux distributions

### `debug`

nvim-dap + UI (Python, Lua, JS/TS, Go)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.debug" }
```

Requires:

- **Python 3**: the Python adapter
  <br />then pip install debugpy
- **Node.js** *(optional)*: the JavaScript and TypeScript adapter
  <br />https://nodejs.org/

### `git`

Fugit2, diffview, git-conflict

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.git" }
```

Requires:

- **libgit2**: fugit2 links against it; the TUI will not load otherwise
  <br />brew install libgit2, or your package manager
- **lazygit** *(optional)*: the &lt;C-w&gt;&lt;C-g&gt; floating terminal
  <br />https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit

### `http`

kulala.nvim HTTP/REST/gRPC/GraphQL client

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.http" }
```

Requires:

- **curl**: kulala sends every request through it
  <br />preinstalled on macOS and most Linux distributions

### `nvim-dev`

StartupTime, Luapad, vimls -- Neovim config development

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.nvim-dev" }
```

Requires:

- **Node.js** *(optional)*: the vimls server Mason installs
  <br />https://nodejs.org/

### `octo`

GitHub PRs/issues/reviews via gh CLI (&lt;C-w&gt;O)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.octo" }
```

Requires:

- **GitHub CLI**: every octo command
  <br />https://cli.github.com/, then gh auth login

### `refactoring`

extract function/variable/block

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.refactoring" }
```

### `repl`

iron.nvim interactive REPL

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.repl" }
```

Requires:

- **a REPL for your language**: iron.nvim drives an external interpreter
  <br />python3, ipython, ghci, node, ... whichever you send code to

### `task-runner`

overseer.nvim + compiler.nvim (run file)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.task-runner" }
```

Requires:

- **your project build tool**: overseer and compiler.nvim shell out to it
  <br />make, cargo, latexmk, npm, ... whatever the project uses

### `test`

neotest test runner

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.tools.test" }
```

Requires:

- **Python 3** *(optional)*: neotest-python is the shipped adapter
  <br />then pip install pytest

## Writing & notes

### `markdown`

render, preview, tables, math, image paste

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.writing.markdown" }
```

Requires:

- **Node.js** *(optional)*: markdown-preview builds its viewer with it, and mdmath renders through it
  <br />https://nodejs.org/
- **a terminal with the kitty graphics protocol** *(optional)*: inline math rendering by mdmath
  <br />kitty, WezTerm, or Ghostty

### `neorg`

.norg wiki / note-taking

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.writing.neorg" }
```

Requires:

- **ImageMagick** *(optional)*: image.nvim renders inline images through it
  <br />brew install imagemagick, or your package manager
- **a terminal with the kitty graphics protocol** *(optional)*: displaying those images
  <br />kitty, WezTerm, or Ghostty

### `obsidian`

Obsidian vault integration (pair with markdown bundle)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.writing.obsidian" }
```

Requires:

- **a vault path**: obsidian.nvim has nothing to open without one
  <br />set it in lua/user/config.lua; see :help noethervim-user-config-data

### `wrapsearch`

search across hard-wrapped lines (/ and ?)

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.writing.wrapsearch" }
```

## Terminal & environment

### `better-term`

named/numbered terminal windows

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.terminal.better-term" }
```

### `remote-dev`

distant.nvim SSH editing

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.terminal.remote-dev" }
```

Requires:

- **distant**: the local half of the connection
  <br />https://distant.dev/
- **distant on the remote host**: the remote half of the connection
  <br />ssh host 'curl -L https://sh.distant.dev | sh'

### `tmux`

automatic tmux window naming

```lua
{ import = "noethervim.bundles.terminal.tmux" }
```

Requires:

- **tmux**: pane navigation and window naming
  <br />brew install tmux, or your package manager
